world: BoxingGym location_finding.Signal, three equal-strength sources in two dimensions
training: 16 public queries per world, independent seeded uniform coordinates in [-2,2]^2, using upstream run_experiment; response rounded by upstream API
evaluation: 32 private heldout coordinates per world from independent seeded N(0,1) draws, using upstream step; coordinates public as forecast questions, responses and source locations private
purpose: Oracle/evaluator and descriptive-versus-anonymous message custody only. No solver, prior, model selection, or performance claim.
forbidden: No Azure or other closed-source model API. Do not expose true source locations to a proposer.
